title: High-efficiency electro-Fenton mineralization of triclosan using a novel octahedral iron(III) complex: structure, mechanism, and performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19687-19701
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01483F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nejmeddine Rabaaoui, Ahlem Guesmi, Wiem Jabeur, Noureddine Mhadhbi, Naoufel Ben Hamadi, Lotfi Khezami, Mourad Cherif, Houcine Naïli
A novel Fe(III) complex, [Fe(CO3)(en)2]Cl, was synthesized and characterized. As a cathodic catalyst in a boron-doped diamond electro-Fenton system, it enabled near-complete triclosan mineralization, showing potential for water treatment.
